integrity: Mathematical proof and finite reproducibility checks provided. No independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one scalar quadratic-plus-linear measurement, isotropic Gaussian prior, classical 2n-point cubature, unconditional MSE not conditional posterior. Rotated-points sensitivity, general CKF moments and prior covariance-compensation theory are prior art; exact spectral boundary has residual publication-priority uncertainty.
title: Sharp spectral calibration boundary for rotated cubature measurements
